newsitem.title: JAPAN: Tokyo stocks close higher, NTT attracts interest.
newsitem.headline: Tokyo stocks close higher, NTT attracts interest.

text.p: Tokyo stocks ended moderately higher on Friday, as issues driven by domestic demand, such as Nippon Telegraph and Telephone Corp (NTT), attracted investors due to the yen's recent firmness against the dollar, brokers said.
But they said the market was somewhat cautious ahead of the U.S. Federal Reserve's policy-setting meeting next week, which may affect Wall Street stocks.
The 225-share Nikkei average gained 268.42 points or 1.34 percent to finish at 20,324.73. Its June futures jumped 310 points to 20,370.
